sentences.en: In Greek mythology, the sirens were alluring sea creatures who sang beautiful and beguiling songs.
sentences.zh: 在希腊神话中，塞壬是迷人的海妖，会唱出动听而诱人的歌声。

sentences.en: Sailors lured by these sirens found themselves running aground on rocks and capsizing.
sentences.zh: 受到这些海妖诱惑的水手们最终会触礁搁浅并船毁人亡。

sentences.en: It's the origin of the phrase, siren song, to describe a temptation that conceals danger.
sentences.zh: 这就是“海妖之歌”这个短语的由来，用来形容掩盖危险的诱惑。

sentences.en: According to Greek mythology, the warrior Ulysses wanted to hear the song of the sirens,
sentences.zh: 根据希腊神话，勇士尤利西斯想要聆听海妖的歌声，

sentences.en: but feared he would lose control of his faculties and run his ship aground.
sentences.zh: 但又担心自己会失去理智，导致船只触礁。

sentences.en: So he had his men bind him to the mast of his own ship.
sentences.zh: 于是他让手下把自己绑在自家船的桅杆上。

sentences.en: When he heard the song of the sirens, the ropes constrained him from giving in to temptation.
sentences.zh: 当他听到海妖的歌声时，绳索限制了他向诱惑屈服。

sentences.en: In modern times, social scientists and lawyers design what are sometimes known as Ulysses Pacts
sentences.zh: 在现代，社会科学家和律师设计了有时被称为“尤利西斯契约”的东西

sentences.en: Exactly as in the myth, these are ways you can limit what you yourself can do in the future
sentences.zh: 正如神话中一样，这些都是你可以用来限制自己未来行为的方法

sentences.en: if you feel you are likely to make mistakes.
sentences.zh: 如果你觉得自己很可能会犯错的话。

sentences.en: If you fear you are at risk for dementia, for example,
sentences.zh: 例如，如果你担心自己有患痴呆症的风险，

sentences.en: you can sign over power of attorney to a relative
sentences.zh: 你可以将委托代理权签署给亲属，

sentences.en: to keep yourself from making poor decisions in the years to come.
sentences.zh: 以此防止自己在未来几年做出糟糕的决定。

sentences.en: States and nations sometimes pass laws to constrain themselves from overspending future budgets.
sentences.zh: 各州和各国家有时会通过法律来限制自己过度透支未来的预算。

sentences.en: When you skip buying chips and soda at the grocery store
sentences.zh: 当你在杂货店里不买薯片和苏打水时

sentences.en: because you worry you will give in to temptation if you keep junk food at home,
sentences.zh: 因为你担心如果家里存着垃圾食品，自己就会向诱惑屈服，

sentences.en: you are crafting a soft version of a Ulysses Pact with yourself.
sentences.zh: 你其实就是在为自己制定一个温和版的尤利西斯契约。

sentences.en: You are constraining what you will do in the future.
sentences.zh: 你正在限制自己未来的行为。

sentences.en: Today, in the next installment of our You 2.0 series,
sentences.zh: 今天，在我们“你 2.0”系列的下一期节目中，

sentences.en: we will explore new research into how to become a better designer of your future self.
sentences.zh: 我们将探讨关于如何更好地规划未来自己的全新研究。

sentences.en: How to craft choices that will make for better tomorrows.
sentences.zh: 如何做出能够造就更美好明天的选择。

The Power of Yes was more than just an advertising slogan.
